exercises.title: Preparation: Matching
exercises.instruction: Match the words with their definitions.

pairs.definition: an opinion or recommendation about what someone should do
to be strongly attracted to doing something
the act of doing something again
a short walk around your local area
to put something over something so that you can't see it
an expression used before the last thing in a list, to say that it is equally as important

exercises.title: Check your understanding: multiple choice
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct option to complete the sentences based on the advice given.

questions.question: Before you start revising, you should...
When you are studying, you should take a break every...
To help remember key facts, you should use...
On the night before the exam, it is best to...

exercises.title: Check your understanding: true or false
exercises.instruction: Decide if the statements are True or False.

questions.statement: You should study without taking any breaks until you finish.
Drinking plenty of water is recommended during study sessions.
Eating healthy snacks helps maintain focus while revising.
